create_LyftDataset: create a LyftDataset instance to load and access Lyft 3D object detection dataset annotations
load_annotations_LyftDataset: load annotations from a Lyft dataset info file sorted by timestamp with configurable sampling interval
evaluate_LyftDataset: evaluate 3D detection results against the Lyft dataset using the official Lyft evaluation protocol
format_results_LyftDataset: format detection results into Lyft JSON submission format and optionally convert to CSV for Kaggle
output_to_lyft_box: convert model detection output dict containing boxes_3d, scores_3d, and labels_3d into LyftBox objects
